punjab_gk2a.unit: Fire detections by GK2A in that hour, per 100 km², October–November
punjab_gk2a.label: Fires seen by the GK2A satellite at {HH}:00 (India time)
punjab_gk2a.coverage: Punjab and Haryana only (the GK2A dataset covers these two states)
punjab_gk2a.method: pixel detections binned to 0.025 deg, Gaussian smoothed (sigma 0.05 deg); same levels for every year and hour

punjab_viirs.unit: Days with a fire detected by the ~1:40 pm satellite (S-NPP VIIRS), per 100 km², October–November
punjab_viirs.label: Fires seen by the ~1:40 pm satellite (S-NPP VIIRS)
punjab_viirs.coverage: Punjab and Haryana (FIRMS points inside the two states)
punjab_viirs.method: 0.05 deg cell-days binned at 0.05 deg, Gaussian smoothed (sigma 0.05 deg); same levels every year
punjab_viirs.note: Different instrument and unit from GK2A: compare years within one panel, not levels across panels

world.unit: Days with a fire detected per year, per 0.25° square (about 28 km), on the VIIRS scale
world.label: Fire activity per year (days with a satellite fire detection, VIIRS-equivalent)
world.method: annual sum of harm per 0.25 deg cell, Gaussian smoothed (sigma 0.19 deg), blank where the cell and its neighbours had no fire
world.hover_rule: hover shows the unsmoothed cell value from tiles/*.json, never the contour value

dropped.passtime: Pass-time lines were built and dropped: medians of fire-detection look times vary with viewing angle, so the lines were too noisy to read. Show pass time as numbers per area from clock/*.json instead.
